taxonomic_note: Accepted by Kew/POWO and ITIS; Texas is within the native range.
look_here_first: Emergent wetland herb with glaucous narrow-elliptic leaves and yellow flowers. In the flower, most showy 'petal-like' parts are staminodes; only one stamen is fertile.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays occurrence is directly supported by the San Marcos River source video. Kew treats Texas as native, but three exact native target-zone counties have not yet been documented.
project_inclusion.learner_role: valuable local morphology species; do not count in native canonical total yet

morphology_keys.joey_field_note: Exceptional Joey sequence: habit -> staminodes -> single fertile stamen -> developing ovary/fruit.
